transcripts_missing_from_translation_mai: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transcripts t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main m WHERE m.transcript_id_1064_key=t.transcript_id_1064_key)
translation_main_missing_or_changed_tran: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t WHERE t.transcript_id_1064_key=m.transcript_id_1064_key AND t.gene_id_1020_key=m.gene_id_1020_key AND t.stable_id_1023=m.stable_id_1023 AND t.stable_id_1066=m.stable_id_1066 AND t.biotype_1064 IS m.biotype_1064)
no_translation_main_rows: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main WHERE translation_id_1068_key IS NULL OR translation_id_1068_key=0
noncoding_no_translation_transcripts: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id_1064_key) FROM main WHERE (translation_id_1068_key IS NULL OR translation_id_1068_key=0) AND biotype_1064!='protein_coding'
untranslated_with_nonblank_swissprot: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main m JOIN swissprot u ON u.translation_id_1068_key=m.translation_id_1068_key WHERE (m.translation_id_1068_key IS NULL OR m.translation_id_1068_key=0) AND u.dbprimary_acc_1074 IS NOT NULL AND u.dbprimary_acc_1074!=''
expected_output_rows:
WITH h AS (SELECT gene_id_1020_key k,COUNT(*) n FROM hgnc GROUP BY 1),
 u AS (SELECT translation_id_1068_key k,COUNT(*) n FROM swissprot GROUP BY 1),
 r AS (SELECT transcript_id_1064_key k,COUNT(*) n FROM refseq GROUP BY 1)
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(h.n,1)*COALESCE(u.n,1)*COALESCE(r.n,1)) FROM main m
LEFT JOIN h ON h.k=m.gene_id_1020_key LEFT JOIN u ON u.k=m.translation_id_1068_key LEFT JOIN r ON r.k=m.transcript_id_1064_key
untranslated_output_rows:
